Args:
    deployment_request (CreateModelDeployment): The deployment request containing model configuration.

Returns:
    Dict[str, float]: A dictionary containing the computed VRAM estimate and the highest node VRAM.

Raises:
    HTTPException: If the model is not found or estimation fails.

POST /serving/start.description:
Start Ray with the given parameters.
If Ray is already running, a RayServiceException is raised.

POST /tool/deploy.description:
Deploy a new Tool server from a Docker image.

This endpoint creates a new Tool deployment and returns a public HTTPS URL
that can be used with any Tool-compatible client.

Args:
    request: Deployment configuration including Docker image and environment variables
    current_user: Authenticated user (injected)

Returns:
    ToolDeployment: Deployment details including the generated public URL

Raises:
    HTTPException: If deployment fails

POST /tool/deploy-template/{}.description:
Deploy a Tool server from a pre-built template.

This is a convenience endpoint that combines template lookup and deployment.

Args:
    template_name: Name of the template (e.g., "tool-websearch")
    name: Name for your deployment instance
    env_vars: Optional environment variables (e.g., API keys)
    current_user: Authenticated user (injected)

Returns:
    ToolDeployment: Deployment details including the generated public URL

Example:
    POST /tool/deploy-template/tool-websearch
    {
        "name": "my-search-tool",
        "env_vars": {
            "TAVILY_API_KEY": "your-api-key"
        }
    }

POST /tool/garden/import.description: Import tool templates from remote catalog (not from local file).

POST /tool/remote/sync.description:
Import new remote tool templates from info.kamiwaza.ai.

Args:
    sync_request: Optional filter for specific template names
    current_user: Authenticated user (injected)
    template_service: Template service (injected)
    stage: Optional stage override (LOCAL/DEV/STAGE/PROD) for support use

Returns:
    Import results including counts and any errors

Raises:
    HTTPException: On validation errors or import failures

PUT /apps/app_templates/{}.description: Update a template using API-provided payload data.

PUT /catalog/datasets/by-urn/schema.description: Update schema by URN using query parameter.

PUT /catalog/datasets/v2/{}/schema.description:
Update schema by URN using regex-based path converter (V2 - RECOMMENDED).

Example: PUT /catalog/datasets/v2/urn:li:dataset:(urn:li:dataPlatform:file,/var/tmp/docs,PROD)/schema

PUT /cluster/federations/{}.description:
Update a cluster federation.

Args:
    federation_id: UUID of the federation
    updates: Dictionary of fields to update
    
Returns:
    Updated ClusterFederation object

PUT /cluster/location/{}.description:
Update an existing location by its ID.

Args:
    location_id (UUID): The unique identifier of the location to update.
    location (CreateLocation): The new data for the location.

Returns:
    Location: The updated location object.

PUT /model_configs/{}.description: Update a model configuration by its ID.

PUT /tool/tool_templates/{}.description: Update an existing tool template (local changes, no remote fetch).
